"""Read-only independent custody review. Writes scratch reviewer receipts only."""
import collections
import concurrent.futures
import csv
import datetime
import hashlib
import io
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time

WT = pathlib.Path('/workspace/e02-F-handoff-index')
SCRATCH = pathlib.Path('/workspace/e02-F-receipts')
PREFIX = 'policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/implementation-handoffs/F/'
FINAL = '386f18e3354bd482bd012434de6ac96df3218b28'
TREE = 'd286a2fb4e7cb0dcfdc8585f660bea5457e450b2'
CI_SOURCE = '65a215b9c8e78f0b12f3da9995d6c8181e93dbc2'
PRIOR = 'eeecc3342e6c3ad6a167ce7ea9ce846796917541'
PYTHON = '/workspace/polisyos/policy-engine/.venv/bin/python'

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(WT), *args])

def text_git(*args):
    return git(*args).decode('utf-8').strip()

def need(condition, reason):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(reason)

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def at(head, path):
    return git('show', f'{head}:{path}')

def save(name, value):
    (SCRATCH / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

def ref(raw):
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw)}

def paths(*args):
    return text_git(*args).splitlines()

def refs(obj, head):
    bound = []
    unadmitted = []
    def walk(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            p = value.get('path')
            if isinstance(p, str) and 'sha256' in value:
                if p.startswith('policy-engine/') and not ('/raw/' in p and str(value.get('transfer', '')).startswith('local')):
                    raw = at(head, p)
                    need(sha(raw) == value['sha256'], f'{head}:{p} hash')
                    need(len(raw) == value.get('bytes', len(raw)), f'{head}:{p} size')
                    bound.append({'path': p, **ref(raw)})
                else:
                    unadmitted.append({'path': p, 'sha256': value['sha256'], 'scope': 'declaration only; no transferred Git byte custody'})
            for child in value.values():
                walk(child)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for child in value:
                walk(child)
    walk(obj)
    return bound, unadmitted

started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
need(text_git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == FINAL, 'not final frozen HEAD')
need(text_git('rev-parse', f'{FINAL}^{{tree}}') == TREE, 'not final frozen tree')
need(text_git('status', '--porcelain') == '', 'root source not clean')
index_raw = at(FINAL, PREFIX + 'INDEX.json')
index = json.loads(index_raw)
source_paths = paths('diff', '--name-only', index['source_base_sha'], FINAL)
source_refs = [{'path': p, **ref(at(FINAL, p))} for p in source_paths]
need(all(p.startswith(PREFIX) for p in source_paths), 'root changed outside delivery docs/receipts')
need(at(PRIOR, PREFIX+'verify_delivery.py') == at(FINAL, PREFIX+'verify_delivery.py'), 'verifier changed from reviewed eeecc')
need(paths('diff', '--name-only', CI_SOURCE, FINAL) == [PREFIX+'INDEX.json'], 'post-CI-source delta not exactly INDEX')

native_runs = []
for name, flags in [('native', []), ('optimized', ['-O'])]:
    receipt_path = SCRATCH / f'foundry-index-final386-{name}.json'
    saved = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    argv = [PYTHON, *flags, PREFIX+'verify_delivery.py', PREFIX+'INDEX.json', '--negative-controls']
    need(saved['command_argv'] == argv and saved['cwd'] == str(WT), name+' original argv/cwd')
    need(saved['source_sha'] == FINAL and saved['source_tree'] == TREE, name+' source identity')
    need(saved['returncode'] == 0 and saved['stderr'] == '', name+' native verdict')
    output_path = pathlib.Path(saved['output']['path'])
    full = output_path.read_bytes()
    need(ref(full) == {k: saved['output'][k] for k in ['bytes','sha256']}, name+' original output custody')
    need(full == saved['stdout'].encode()+saved['stderr'].encode(), name+' full stdout/stderr')
    result = json.loads(saved['stdout'])
    need(result == saved['result'] and result['outcome'] == 'PASS', name+' result identity')
    need(len(result['negative_controls_rejected']) == 8, name+' controls not eight')
    saved['recovery_verified_original_run'] = {'path':str(receipt_path), **ref(receipt_path.read_bytes()), 'complete_output_read':True, 'scope':'Completed original admitted runner execution at exact386; no repeated numeric/broad test and no substituted outcome.'}
    native_runs.append(saved)

owner_prefix = 'policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/execution-organization/'
findings = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(at(index['source_base_sha'], owner_prefix+'finding-owners.tsv').decode()), delimiter='\t'))
finding_owner = {r['finding_id']: r for r in findings if r['unit']=='F'}
bundles = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(at(index['source_base_sha'], owner_prefix+'bundle-owners.tsv').decode()), delimiter='\t'))
expected_bundles = {r['bundle_id'] for r in bundles if r['unit']=='F'}
need(len(expected_bundles)==17 and len(finding_owner)==35, 'independent owner denominator')
need(len(index['bundle_ids'])==17 and set(index['bundle_ids'])==expected_bundles, 'bundles duplicated/omitted')
need(len(index['finding_residuals'])==35 and len({r['finding_id'] for r in index['finding_residuals']})==35, 'finding uniqueness')
need(index['accepted_finding_closures']==[] and index['integration_acceptance']=='pending_G', 'false F closure/acceptance')
for row in index['finding_residuals']:
    expected = finding_owner[row['finding_id']]
    need(row['closure_owner']==expected['source_closure_owner'], row['finding_id']+' owner')
    need(row['ledger_status_preserved']==expected['source_status'], row['finding_id']+' source status')
    need(set(row['bundle_ids'])==set(expected['source_bundle_ids'].split(',')), row['finding_id']+' membership')
    need(row['candidate_semantic_state'] in ['held','limited_no_ledger_closure','limited_principal_decision_pending'], row['finding_id']+' promoted')
    if row['finding_id']=='B219': need(row['candidate_semantic_state']=='held', 'B219 promoted')
index_bound, index_unadmitted = refs(index, FINAL)

slices = []
footprints = []
final_footprints = []
for item in index['slices']:
    head = item['published_head_sha']
    raw = at(head,item['receipt_path'])
    receipt = json.loads(raw)
    need(sha(raw)==item['receipt_sha256'] and len(raw)==item['receipt_bytes'], item['slice']+' receipt')
    need(receipt['implementation_commits']==item['implementation_commits'], item['slice']+' commits')
    need(receipt['candidate_tree_sha']==item['candidate_tree_sha']==text_git('rev-parse',receipt['implementation_commits'][-1]+'^{tree}'), item['slice']+' tree')
    footprint = set()
    for c in receipt['implementation_commits']:
        git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',c,head)
        footprint.update(paths('diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','-r',c))
    need(footprint==set(receipt['changed_paths']), item['slice']+' exact footprint')
    after = paths('diff','--name-only',receipt['implementation_commits'][-1],head)
    need(not any(p.startswith(('policy-engine/src/','policy-engine/tests/')) for p in after), item['slice']+' source freeze')
    bound, unadmitted = refs(receipt, head)
    full_paths = set(paths('diff','--name-only',index['source_base_sha'],head))
    footprints.append(footprint)
    final_footprints.append(full_paths)
    slices.append({'slice':item['slice'],'branch':item['branch'],'head':head,'implementation_commits':receipt['implementation_commits'],'candidate_tree':receipt['candidate_tree_sha'],'receipt':{'path':item['receipt_path'],**ref(raw)},'exact_implementation_paths':sorted(footprint),'source_after_freeze':[],'final_diff_path_count':len(full_paths),'bound_git_refs':bound,'unadmitted_ref_declarations':unadmitted,'checks_identity':[{k:c[k] for k in ['target_sha','outcome','scope','interpretation','passed','skipped','errors'] if k in c} for c in receipt['checks']]})
for i,f in enumerate(footprints):
    for g in footprints[i+1:]: need(not f.intersection(g),'implementation footprint conflict')
for i,f in enumerate(final_footprints):
    for g in final_footprints[i+1:]: need(not f.intersection(g),'final topic footprint conflict')

manifest_path = PREFIX+'ci-evidence/transfer-manifest.json'
manifest_raw = at(FINAL,manifest_path)
manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw)
manifest_rows = manifest['files']+manifest['selections']
need(len(manifest['files'])==manifest['files_count']==208 and len(manifest['selections'])==5, 'CI manifest denominator')
need(len(manifest_rows)==213 and len({r['path'] for r in manifest_rows})==213, 'CI uniqueness')
need(len(index['CI_evidence_files'])==213, 'INDEX CI count')
manifest_fields = ['path','sha256','bytes','encoding','original_bytes','original_sha256','sanitation']
need(index['CI_evidence_files']==[{k:r[k] for k in manifest_fields} for r in manifest_rows], 'INDEX manifest identity')
ci_audit = []
local_available = 0
raw_sum = 0
for item in manifest_rows:
    raw = at(FINAL,item['path'])
    need(raw==at(CI_SOURCE,item['path']), 'CI bytes changed after65 '+item['path'])
    need(ref(raw)=={k:item[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256']}, 'CI artifact identity '+item['path'])
    value = json.loads(raw)
    if item['encoding']=='original complete UTF-8 JSON bytes':
        decoded = raw
        kind = 'original_JSON'
    elif item['encoding']=='lossless UTF-8 text in JSON content; decode content.encode(utf-8)':
        need(value['schema']=='policyos.e02.complete_text_log.v1','wrapper schema')
        decoded = value['content'].encode('utf-8')
        need(ref(decoded)=={'bytes':value['raw_bytes'],'sha256':value['raw_sha256']},'wrapper raw identity '+item['path'])
        kind = 'lossless_text_wrapper'
    else: raise ValueError('unknown encoding '+item['encoding'])
    need(ref(decoded)=={'bytes':item['original_bytes'],'sha256':item['original_sha256']}, 'CI decoded identity '+item['path'])
    need(item['sanitation']=='none added by root','unexpected sanitation')
    local = item.get('original_local_path')
    source_verified = None
    if local and pathlib.Path(local).is_file():
        need(pathlib.Path(local).read_bytes()==decoded,'original local bytes not equal '+local)
        source_verified = 'available scratch bytes equal decoded; Git custody separately established'
        local_available += 1
    if item.get('cluster')=='G-observed':
        need(decoded==at(item['source_sha'],item['original_repository_path']), 'G source identity')
        source_verified = 'immutable institutional source Git object equal copied bytes'
    raw_sum += len(decoded)
    ci_audit.append({'path':item['path'],'cluster':item['cluster'], 'artifact':ref(raw),'decoded_original':ref(decoded),'kind':kind,'source_bytes_comparison':source_verified})
need(sum(r['bytes'] for r in manifest['files'])==manifest['committed_evidence_bytes'],'manifest 208 artifact bytes')
selection_bytes = sum(r['bytes'] for r in manifest['selections'])
all_213_committed_bytes = sum(r['bytes'] for r in manifest_rows)
need(all_213_committed_bytes == manifest['committed_evidence_bytes'] + selection_bytes, 'all213 total bytes')
tracked_ci = set(paths('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',FINAL,'--',PREFIX+'ci-evidence/'))
metadata_paths = {manifest_path, PREFIX+'ci-evidence/README.md'} | {PREFIX+'ci-evidence/'+c+'/README.md' for c in ['canary','economics','schema','docs','python','G-observed']}
need(tracked_ci == {r['path'] for r in manifest_rows} | metadata_paths, 'extra/missing CI tracked files beyond exact producer-defined metadata')
metadata_refs=[]
for metadata_path in sorted(metadata_paths):
    metadata_raw=at(FINAL,metadata_path)
    need(metadata_raw == at(CI_SOURCE,metadata_path),'CI metadata bytes changed after65 '+metadata_path)
    metadata_refs.append({'path':metadata_path, **ref(metadata_raw), 'basis':'Exact producer-defined CI publication metadata; not one of213deciding evidence files.'})
selection_audit = []
for cluster, key, locator in [('canary','all_files','path'),('economics','proposed_git_files','local_path'),('schema','required_files','path'),('docs','items','source_path'),('python','items','path')]:
    selection = json.loads(at(FINAL,PREFIX+'ci-evidence/'+cluster+'/selection.json'))
    selected = selection[key]
    actual = [r for r in manifest['files'] if r['cluster']==cluster]
    need(len(selected)==len(actual),cluster+' selection count')
    original_map = {r['original_local_path']:r for r in actual}
    need(set(original_map)=={r[locator] for r in selected},cluster+' selection full paths')
    for row in selected:
        r = original_map[row[locator]]
        need(row['sha256']==r['original_sha256'] and row['bytes']==r['original_bytes'],cluster+' selection original identity')
    selection_audit.append({'cluster':cluster,'selected_files':len(selected),'complete_path_set_and_original_hashes':'PASS','original_bytes':sum(r['original_bytes'] for r in actual)})

g_checkpoint = json.loads(at(FINAL,PREFIX+'ci-evidence/G-observed/checkpoint-03.json'))
g_api = json.loads(at(FINAL,PREFIX+'ci-evidence/G-observed/f-api.json'))
institution = index['G_institutional_observation']
need(institution['source_sha']==index['integration_observed_head']=='15d50bac59d06a3fb010327abf8e0c90f9ccbed0','G observed identity')
need(institution['finding_closures']==[] and institution['full_F_delivery_acceptance']=='pending_G','G false closure')
need(len(institution['accepted_earlier_F_slices'])==1,'G accepted slice count')
accepted = institution['accepted_earlier_F_slices'][0]
need(accepted['accepted_head']=='baada065af0aaa4edafb8d53abce5fd797de2c6c' and accepted['candidate_sha']=='0c709ea924d2b868eacf1016f5c70ff749e287a8' and accepted['finding_closure'] is False,'G bounded acceptance')

docs_delta = []
for slice_name, prior, runtime, doc in [('cau-cohort-admission','6a6ddfe9542000914bffd6502d72a166c1d33261','c8e16d0abb7d10605475862ede8c6f327ff7cce9','d27227d03a7c78b90c442e6f258c45987104f8a1'),('api-consumer-abi','baada065af0aaa4edafb8d53abce5fd797de2c6c','0c709ea924d2b868eacf1016f5c70ff749e287a8','4b8cdf8ab88006c572c2b2d0039053d5a0138f14')]:
    item = next(x for x in index['slices'] if x['slice']==slice_name)
    head = item['published_head_sha']
    r = json.loads(at(head,item['receipt_path']))
    runtime_delta = paths('diff','--name-only',runtime,head,'--','policy-engine/src/','policy-engine/tests/')
    need(runtime_delta==[],slice_name+' runtime docs changed')
    delta_paths = paths('diff','--name-only',prior,head)
    need(all(p.startswith('policy-engine/docs/') for p in delta_paths),slice_name+' docs-only delta')
    need(all(c['target_sha'] not in [doc,head] for c in r['checks'] if 'pytest' in c.get('command','')),slice_name+' fake fresh native SHA')
    doc_checks = [c for c in r['checks'] if c.get('target_sha')==doc]
    need(any(c['outcome']=='FAIL' for c in doc_checks),slice_name+' full Docs FAIL missing')
    need(all(c['outcome'] in ['PASS','FAIL','ERROR','SKIP','UNRUN'] for c in r['checks']),slice_name+' outcome enum')
    docs_delta.append({'slice':slice_name,'prior_head':prior,'final_head':head,'runtime_implementation':runtime,'doc_implementation':doc,'runtime_src_test_diff':runtime_delta,'delta_paths':delta_paths,'native_sha_preserved':'PASS','full_DocsGate':'FAIL','strict_build':'UNRUN','check_outcomes':[{k:c[k] for k in ['target_sha','outcome','scope','interpretation'] if k in c} for c in r['checks']],'source_tree':r['candidate_tree_sha'],'nested_git_refs_verified':len(refs(r,head)[0])})
api_receipt_path = next(x['receipt_path'] for x in index['slices'] if x['slice']=='api-consumer-abi')
old_api = json.loads(at('6ebc4bf62c04d1f5f068bcef736099f0280ea3c0',api_receipt_path))
new_api = json.loads(at('0b6d872d8a681b1725abb5e2e3f57f9668e31c69',api_receipt_path))
need(paths('diff','--name-only','6ebc4bf62c04d1f5f068bcef736099f0280ea3c0','0b6d872d8a681b1725abb5e2e3f57f9668e31c69')==[api_receipt_path],'API correction extra paths')
old_api['checks'][5]['outcome']='PASS'
old_api['checks'][5]['scope']='Bounded docs-companion path predicate only; separate actual full Docs Gate remains FAIL1 and strict_docs_build UNRUN.'
need(old_api==new_api,'API correction unrelated content')

def remote_review(item):
    pr = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh','pr','view',item['pull_request'],'--json','headRefOid,state,isDraft,baseRefName,url'],cwd=WT))
    raw = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(WT),'ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/'+item['branch']]).decode()
    remote_sha = raw.split()[0]
    need(remote_sha==pr['headRefOid']==item['published_head_sha'],item['slice']+' remote/PR mismatch')
    need(pr['state']=='OPEN' and pr['isDraft'] is True and pr['baseRefName']=='main',item['slice']+' PR scope')
    return {'slice':item['slice'],'branch':item['branch'],'published_head':item['published_head_sha'],'remote_readback':raw,'PR':pr}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as pool:
    remote = list(pool.map(remote_review,index['slices']))
remote_main = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(WT),'ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/main']).decode()
need(remote_main.split()[0]==index['source_base_sha'],'main advanced or mismatch')
remote_integration = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(WT),'ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/codex/e02-integration']).decode()
original_cwd = '/workspace/polisyos'
original = {'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',original_cwd,'branch','--show-current']).decode().strip(),'sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',original_cwd,'rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip(),'status':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',original_cwd,'status','--porcelain']).decode(),'local_main_refs':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',original_cwd,'for-each-ref','--format=%(refname) %(objectname)','refs/heads/main']).decode()}
need(original['branch']=='work' and original['sha']=='0a4b9cd48068454bb8ce95b5ae69bf5c323ee924' and original['status']=='','original checkout altered')
need(text_git('rev-parse','HEAD')==FINAL and text_git('status','--porcelain')=='','source mutated during review')
need(source_refs==[{'path':p,**ref(at(FINAL,p))} for p in source_paths], 'source immutable snapshot changed')

result = {'schema':'policyos.e02.independent_delivery_review.v1','reviewer':'F/graph_scm recovery leaf; independent root-index custody audit; read-only, no children','started_utc':started,'finished_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_sha':FINAL,'source_tree':TREE,'outcome':'GO','scope':'Bookkeeping/source freeze/complete transferred Git custody and bounded documentation delta only. No product, real-data, backend-marker, scientific, whole-F or finding closure acceptance. Broad red/skip/unrun outcomes retained.','source_files':source_refs,'implementation_commits':['3d440cfac134728d31ffb49ac70911576cec4e2f',PRIOR,CI_SOURCE,'191dc1da8ef64e6219afaff9c87e92d3a52028cd',FINAL],'verifier_source':{'path':PREFIX+'verify_delivery.py',**ref(at(FINAL,PREFIX+'verify_delivery.py')),'unchanged_since':PRIOR},'native_replays':native_runs,'denominator':{'bundles':17,'findings':35,'slices':9,'ledger_status_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r['ledger_status_preserved'] for r in index['finding_residuals'])),'candidate_state_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r['candidate_semantic_state'] for r in index['finding_residuals'])),'accepted_closures':[],'integration_acceptance':'pending_G'},'index_git_refs':index_bound,'index_unadmitted_refs':index_unadmitted,'slices':slices,'exact_implementation_paths_pairwise_disjoint':True,'full_final_topic_paths_pairwise_disjoint':True,'docs_delta':docs_delta,'API_outcome_normalization':{'before':'PASS bounded companion predicate; full gate FAIL1','after':'PASS + separate bounded scope','only_receipt_metadata_changed':True,'full_docs_gate':'FAIL','strict_docs_build':'UNRUN','source_and_native_SHA_unchanged':True},'CI_transfer':{'immutable_CI_source_sha':CI_SOURCE,'manifest':{'path':manifest_path,**ref(manifest_raw)},'artifacts':208,'selection_files':5,'total_files':213,'artifact_bytes':manifest['committed_evidence_bytes'],'selection_bytes':selection_bytes,'all_213_committed_bytes':all_213_committed_bytes,'decoded_original_bytes':raw_sum,'encoding_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r['kind'] for r in ci_audit)),'all_CI_tracked_paths_with_publication_metadata':len(tracked_ci),'publication_metadata_refs':metadata_refs,'all_213_final_vs65_Git_bytes_identical':True,'all_213_artifact_hash_size_verified':True,'all_decoded_original_hash_size_verified':True,'original_local_files_available_and_byte_compared':local_available,'source_G_bytes_compared':2,'complete_selection_denominators':selection_audit,'files':ci_audit,'CI_outcomes_retained':index['CI_cluster_outcomes']},'institutional_G':{'observation':institution,'complete_checkpoint':g_checkpoint,'complete_deciding_API_receipt':g_api,'observed_source_sha':institution['source_sha'],'integration_remote_at_review':remote_integration,'current_acceptance':'pending_G, historical earlier API acceptance only; no current head/whole F/finding closure inference'},'remote_PR_readback':remote,'remote_main':remote_main,'original_checkout':original,'historical_companion_gap':json.loads((SCRATCH/'foundry-index-original-companion-gap.json').read_text()),'historical_prior_eeecc_GO':{'path':str(SCRATCH/'foundry-index-final-review.json'),**ref((SCRATCH/'foundry-index-final-review.json').read_bytes()),'scope':'Prior eeecc immutable reviewer receipt retained; final386 reviews new docs/CI transfer and final metadata.'},'limitations':['Prior3d native PASS had incomplete companion coverage; actual zero-hash false acceptance retained as KNOWN_GAP, fixed eeecc and now rejected normal/-O.','Current native verification means receipt/source bookkeeping only, not numeric product or scientific acceptance.','Large local ignored raw source declarations are not Git custody and no runtime proof follows from a static scanner partial PASS.','All fresh/current-head CI and full broad Gates remain pending/FAIL/SKIP/UNRUN as explicitly recorded. Root actual final DocsGate run is separate.','Full production inputs remain local; data/estimand/authority residuals and B219 held remain.']}
result['reviewergraph_recovery'] = {'original_runner_path':str(SCRATCH/'foundry-index-final386-audit.py'), **ref((SCRATCH/'foundry-index-final386-audit.py').read_bytes()), 'orchestration_repair':'Original reviewer compared the sum of208artifacts+5selection files against manifest committed_evidence_bytes defined by producer as208artifact files only. Original reviewer also omitted exactly six producer-written cluster READMEs from CI tracked inventory. Recovery admits only those six exact paths, hashes all eight metadata files including rootREADME/manifest and compares bytes to65; arbitrary extras still fail.', 'original_native_and_optimized_runs_recovered':True, 'remaining_custody_checks_reexecuted_read_only':True, 'service_failure':'Original foundry reviewer model-at-capacity interrupted orchestration after complete native runs; no completed final review receipt existed.'}
save('foundry-index-final386-review.json',result)
docs_report={'schema':'policyos.e02.independent_docs_delta_review.v1','source_index_sha':FINAL,'outcome':'GO bounded docs/source/receipt custody only','docs_delta':docs_delta,'API_correction':result['API_outcome_normalization'],'remote_PR_readback':remote,'remote_main':remote_main,'original_checkout':original,'notes':['Runtime src/test byte identity and native target SHA preserved; doc companions do not renew numeric/backend/real-data authority.','Canonical outcome normalized append-only; bounded predicate PASS and separate full gate FAIL/strictbuild UNRUN preserved.','191 acceptance stale prose fixed by exact one-line386 change; no false current G acceptance.']}
save('foundry-index-final386-graph-recovery-docs-review.json',docs_report)
text_lines=['Independent F leaf final delivery review\n'+json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['source_sha','source_tree','outcome','scope','denominator','verifier_source']},indent=2), 'Full independent transferred CI summary\n'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result['CI_transfer'].items() if k!='files'},indent=2), 'Full docs delta audit\n'+json.dumps(docs_report,indent=2), 'Original actual3d companion gap\n'+json.dumps(result['historical_companion_gap'],indent=2)]
